findings.evidence: grep `firstChernClass|def chernClass` in code/TauCeti: no hits; only `def complexEulerClass` in Orientation/Complex/EulerClass.lean:72.
findings.fix: Delete the clause, or reword it as the mathematical motivation (the first Chern class of E is classically defined as that of det E) without implying a Tau Ceti declaration.
findings.issue: The module docstring says `det E` "is the complex line bundle whose first Chern class is the first Chern class of E". No first Chern class exists in Tau Ceti; this restates the planned roadmap definition c₁(E)=c₁(det E) as a fact.

findings.evidence: Statement: `IsInducing (chartCoord (𝕜 := 𝕜) e hx)`; the `Homeomorph.mk` in the proof is not exported.
findings.fix: Reword to "A chart coordinate is an inducing map (indeed a homeomorphism onto 𝕜)", or state and expose the homeomorphism itself.
findings.issue: The `isInducing_chartCoord` docstring says "A chart coordinate is a homeomorphism onto 𝕜", but the statement only gives `IsInducing (chartCoord e hx)`.

findings.evidence: The section variables give `[FiberBundle F E] [VectorBundle 𝕜 F E]` and `[FiberBundle F E'] [VectorBundle 𝕜 F E']` with a single F; `congrEquiv`'s docstring says "with the same model fibre".
findings.fix: Say "between two vector bundles with the same finite-dimensional model fibre `F`".
findings.issue: The `congrHomeomorph` docstring says "between vector bundles with finite-dimensional model fibres", suggesting any two models. The statement requires both E and E' to have the same model fibre F.

summary: Documentation is complete, but the module docstring states the first Chern class of `det E` as a fact when Tau Ceti has no first Chern class, and two docstrings promise more than their statements deliver.
